title: Private Art Gallery Tour in Old Montreal
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Spoil yourself with an exclusive art gallery tour along the city’s charming cobblestone streets. Set in Montreal's Old Port nieghborhood, this walking tour grants privileged access to a handpicked selection of contemporary local galleries. Immerse yourself in a world where Canadian masterpieces and distinguished international works converge, including a rare selection of exquisite Inuit Art. A beginner-friendly experience which invites art enthusiasts of all levels to explore works from Canadian artists and more. Stroll along the historic St. Paul Street, where every step reveals a tapestry of culture and elegance, transforming window shopping into an art form of its own.

No prior experience is necessary, just a curiosity and enthusiasm for creativity.
